authorization_basis: The user explicitly instructed Codex to continue immediately after Phase 1 reported that Phase 2 required separate explicit authorization.

preexecution_contract.local_snapshot: Use the latest exact historical-master snapshot in the bound normalized archive, expected 2026-06-30. Never backfill that snapshot with current membership.
preexecution_contract.instrument_population: Start with every same-snapshot JPX row whose bound historical product_category is ETF. Use official JPX product/index classifications and methodology identities to assign the three inventory classes. Do not select a preferred product inside a class.

classes.BROAD_JAPAN_EQUITY_INDEX: Every unlevered, non-inverse listed ETF in the snapshot whose primary-source tracked index is a broad Japanese equity market index. Include all mechanical matches; exclude active, thematic, style, dividend, minimum-variance, covered-call, currency, commodity, bond, leveraged, and inverse products.
classes.JAPAN_EQUITY_SECTOR_OR_INDUSTRY_INDEX: Every unlevered, non-inverse listed ETF in the snapshot whose primary-source tracked index is explicitly a Japanese equity sector or industry index. Include all mechanical matches; exclude broad, thematic, style, leveraged, and inverse products.
classes.JPY_CASH_OR_CASH_EQUIVALENT: Every listed instrument in the snapshot whose primary-source methodology explicitly tracks JPY cash, an overnight JPY rate, or JPY government discount bills with maximum remaining maturity of one year. Do not relabel a longer-duration bond ETF as cash-equivalent. A zero-member class is allowed and is not rescued by relaxing this definition.

preexecution_contract.individual_stock_baseline: Assess all exact-snapshot ordinary-equity master rows only as an aggregate lot/data-coverage baseline. Do not enrich, rank, or enumerate them as Phase 2 allocation candidates.
preexecution_contract.leverage_exclusions: Exclude any product explicitly classified as leveraged, inverse, double-inverse, bear, or synthetic geared exposure before descriptive fields are compared.
preexecution_contract.descriptive_window: For each inventoried instrument, use at most the last 60 completed TSE sessions ending on 2026-06-30 to report source-row count, non-null turnover count, and median turnover_jpy. Do not read or persist price values and do not use the statistic to select or rank products.
preexecution_contract.point_in_time_coverage: Report historical master snapshot count, first/last snapshot, daily OHLCV date range, explicit distribution adjustment availability, explicit corporate-action/termination/lineage availability, and source provenance. Absence remains false or unknown; do not infer it from survival.
preexecution_contract.kabu_compatibility: Documentation may establish generic support for exchange/product/order lifecycle. Product-specific quote, board-registration, and order-route compatibility remains NOT_VERIFIED because broker endpoints may not be called in Phase 2.
preexecution_contract.source_capture: Prefer official machine-readable JPX lists, product pages, index methodologies, J-Quants specifications, and official kabu station API specifications. Save only the exact primary artifacts used, with URL, retrieval timestamp, content type, byte size, and SHA-256. If robots, access controls, or changing pages prevent capture, record NOT_CAPTURED rather than substituting a secondary source.
preexecution_contract.decision: An instrument class is NO_GO if any included instrument lacks a consistent point-in-time entry/exit/distribution/corporate-action/termination contract, if product-level primary-source provenance is incomplete, or if required kabu quote/board/order compatibility is not verified. GO is only data-foundation eligibility and authorizes no selection, Phase 3, strategy, paper, or live work.
prohibited_outputs: risk-adjusted performance, volatility, drawdown, rank IC, PnL, or profit factor
winner, preferred instrument, score, ranking, or recommendation
portfolio weights, lot rounding, or 2M geometry
